author: GNiendorf
body:
#### Summary
  Retrains the T5 and T4 DNNs with new inputs and adds high-pT jets to training sample. In the HLT this roughly halves the high-pT fake rate in QCD jets and raises high-pT and displaced efficiency. Timing is equal or better.

See slides with more info: [LST-DNN-Retrain.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32802950/LST-DNN-Retrain.pdf)
  
  #### Changes
  **T5 DNN**
  - 3 outputs (fake / prompt / displaced) and 12 new inputs: mini-doublet direction test, parent-triplet scores, hit density and dxy.
  - One pT x eta working-point table. Every T5 that passes can become a track candidate (no more tightCutFlag).
  - T5 duplicate cleaning uses the DNN score at all pT.
  - Removed: the r-phi score, the T5 non-anchor chi2 and tightCutFlag.

  **T4 DNN**
  - 6 new inputs: MD direction, density and dxy (the triplet scores were already inputs).
  - One pT x eta table on P(displaced), replacing two 25-bin tables.
  - Small change to T4 duplicate cleaning, reducing number of shared hits required to flag as duplicates.

  **Both**
  - Trained on PU200 ttbar (1000 events), QCD high-pT jets (500 events) and a displaced-muon gun (10k events, 10 muons each, pT 0.5-50 GeV, vertices within 5 cm).
  - The cheap dBeta and r-z cuts now run before the DNN inputs are computed (timing improves overall from this).
  - (not for review) The standalone training notebooks are replaced by scripts (train / working point / parity / install) plus the working-point tables. `-d` builds write the new inputs (t5x_*, t4x_* branches).

  #### HLT results (Phase-2 menu, 5000 events each, hltGeneralTracks)
  | QCD, pT-hat 1.8-2.4 TeV, PU200 | current LST | this PR |
  |---|---|---|
  | Efficiency, 100-1000 GeV | 31.6% | 56.6% |
  | Efficiency, 10-100 GeV | 77.0% | 84.4% |
  | Fake rate, 10-40 GeV | 18.4% | 9.1% |
  | Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 10-30 / 30-60 cm | 57.3 / 26.5% | 67.5 / 38.3% |
  | Duplicate rate | 0.97% | 1.00% |

  | ttbar, PU200 | current LST | this PR |
  |---|---|---|
  | Efficiency, 0.9-10 GeV | 90.6% | 90.7% |
  | Fake rate, 10-40 / 40-100 GeV | 7.3 / 12.1% | 4.8 / 7.1% |
  | Displaced efficiency, r_vtx 10-30 / 30-60 cm | 67.1 / 45.3% | 69.6 / 50.5% |
  | Duplicate rate | 1.00% | 1.02% |

  #### Timing
  HLT (Phase-2 menu, ttbar PU200, 4 jobs x 16 threads/streams, 2 runs each): throughput unchanged on CPU and GPU, `hltLST` CPU time unchanged.
  
  #### Plots
  Full MTV plots (current LST vs + T5/T4 DNN retrain, 5000 events): [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr277/dnn_ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots/pr277/dnn_qcd/plots_hlt.html)
